title: ROIgrow
description: A program to expand an ROI on the surface.

input_surface.description: Specify input surface. You can also use -t* and -spec and -surf methods to input surfaces.
input_surface.title: Input Surface

roi_labels.description: Data column containing integer labels of ROIs. Each integer label gets grown separately.
roi_labels.title: ROI Labels

lim_distance.description: Distance to cover from each node. The units of LIM are those of the surface's node coordinates. Distances are calculated along the surface's mesh.
lim_distance.title: Limit Distance

output_prefix.description: Prefix of 1D output dataset. Default is ROIgrow
output_prefix.title: Output Prefix

full_list.description: Output a row for each node on the surface. Nodes not in the grown ROI, receive a 0 for a label. This option is ONLY for use with -roi_labels.
full_list.title: Full List Flag

grow_from_edge.description: Grow ROIs from their edges rather than the brute force default. This might make the program faster on large ROIs and large surfaces.
grow_from_edge.title: Grow From Edge Flag

insphere_diameter.description: Diameter of the sphere inside which nodes are added instead of growing along the surface.
insphere_diameter.title: Insphere Diameter

inbox_edges.description: Use a box of edge widths E1, E2, E3 instead of DIA.
inbox_edges.title: Inbox Edges
